name: comp-507
title: Date Range Preset Picker
description: A bordered panel pairing a column of range shortcuts (Today, Yesterday, Last 7 days, Last month and more) with a month calendar. Presets jump the month and shade their span while future days stay greyed out.
use: People mostly want standard reporting periods and only occasionally a made-up span.
avoid: Only past dates can be chosen, so it cannot be reused for booking or scheduling ahead.
a11y: Presets are plain text buttons with no pressed state, so a screen reader cannot tell which range is active. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A black panel split by a divider: the left strip stacks eight small text buttons, the right holds "November 2026" between angle arrows, weekday initials and day numbers. Chosen ranges get white circular ends and a grey band, and days after today are dimmed.
behaves: Pressing a shortcut repaints the calendar for that period: Last month fills all of October and moves the month back. Picking days by hand sets new ends, and clicking elsewhere on the grid restarts the range.
customise: The eight preset labels and the last-seven-days default are written in the file; changing presets, the past-only rule or the caption is a source edit.
weight: light: A single month grid and eight text buttons; nothing animates.
